articles.summary: Global government bonds sold off for a third consecutive month in September, as higher energy prices, heavy debt issuance and a series of central bank policy decisions weighed on markets. Yields on many 10-year benchmark bonds rose by at least 25 basis points over the month, with the French 10-year yield ending the month 67 basis points higher at 4.84%. Preliminary data from statistics agency INSEE showed that annual inflation accelerated to 3.0% in September, from 2.4% in August.
articles.title: Tradeweb Government Bond Update – September 2026

articles.summary: In this Q&A, Charlie Campbell-Johnston, Head of AiEX and Workflow Solutions, and Leo Selya, Head of Algorithmic Trading, at Tradeweb, discuss how automation and AI are converging on the trading desk, and where the industry is moving from theory to practical, everyday application.
articles.title: From Automation to Execution: How AI is Reshaping Fixed Income Trading

articles.summary: South Africa is replacing its long-standing interest rate benchmark, JIBAR, with a new risk-free rate called ZARONIA. JIBAR is due to cease at the end of 2026, so the move is now in its final stretch. We explore what the transition means for market participants, which dates matter most, and how Tradeweb is supporting clients through the switch.
articles.title: Understanding ZARONIA: South Africa’s Transition to a New Risk-Free Rate

articles.summary: NEW YORK – October 6, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported total trading volume for the month of September 2026 of $81.6 trillion (tn). Average daily volume ("ADV") for the month was $3.7tn, an increase of 29.0 percent (%) year-over-year ("YoY"). For the third quarter of 2026, total trading volume was $210.3tn and ADV was $3.2tn, an increase of 22.4% YoY, with preliminary average variable fees per million dollars of volume traded of $2.09 and total preliminary fixed fees for rates, credit, equities and money markets of $99.7 million (mm)1. Tradeweb opportunistically repurchased 2.0mm shares of Class A common stock for $210mm during the third quarter of 2026 given current share price levels, bringing year-to-date repurchases to 4.4mm shares for $449mm.
articles.title: Tradeweb Reports September 2026 Total Trading Volume of $81.6 Trillion and Average Daily Volume of $3.7 Trillion

articles.title: Tradeweb Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: The constraint facing investors in Asia-Pacific (APAC) local currency bond markets has shifted from market access to execution workflow. With liquidity continuing to deepen across most Asian government bond markets and increasingly supporting broader participation, automation has become the main differentiator for trading these instruments at scale. This analysis, drawn from our vantage point operating Tradeweb's electronic trading platform, examines why operational challenges, not liquidity, is now what determines how efficiently international investors can build and scale local currency exposure.
articles.title: From Access to Execution: Scaling APAC Local Currency Bond Trading

articles.summary: The electronification of the U.S. credit market over the last ten years has led to huge changes in how clients and dealers trade bonds. From the growth of portfolio trading to parameter-based automated execution to interdealer sweeps, electronification has changed the market microstructure significantly, allowing for greater efficiency and cost savings.
articles.title: Tradeweb Ai-Price: Evolving Credit Pricing for Today’s Market

articles.summary: NEW YORK (OCTOBER 6, 2026) -- Capitolis, the financial technology company, today announced the successful completion of $220 million of financing. The financing comprised a $120 million Series E equity financing round at a $1.9 billion valuation, as well as debt. The equity financing was led by Citi, an existing investor, with participation from new strategic investors Bank of America, Nomura, and Tradeweb Markets, as well as existing investors Barclays, BNP Paribas, J.P. Morgan, State Street, and UBS. Additional existing and new financial investors also participated in the round. Debt financing will be provided by First Citizens Innovation Banking (formerly Silicon Valley Bank), Hercules Capital, and Pinegrove Venture Partners.
articles.title: Capitolis Announces $220 Million in Financing, Including $120 Million Series E at $1.9 Billion Valuation, from Bank of America, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, J.P. Morgan, Nomura, State Street, UBS, Tradeweb, and Others

articles.summary: NEW YORK – October 19, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW) (“Tradeweb” or the “Company”), a global leader in electronic trading facilitating more than $3.0 trillion in value per day across asset classes, announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Trumid Holdings, LLC (“Trumid”), a financial technology company and electronic credit trading marketplace, for a purchase price of approximately $1.97 billion, subject to customary adjustments, which is comprised of $1.75 billion for the business and approximately $220 million for tax assets being acquired.
articles.title: Tradeweb to Acquire Trumid, Expanding Tradeweb’s Credit Capabilities Across the Entire Bond Lifecycle and Further Differentiating its Multi-Asset Class Platform

articles.summary: Trading activity on the Tradeweb European ETF marketplace reached EUR 69 billion in September, the second-highest level recorded for the month. articles.summary: New York/London/Hong Kong/Singapore/Sydney, Oct. 28, 2026 ‒ The Depository Trust Company (DTC), a subsidiary of The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry, today launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS). The service brings tokenized securities into regulated financial markets through trusted, resilient and scalable market infrastructure, enabling investors to move assets more efficiently, access new liquidity pools and mobilize collateral within minutes.
